Segundo a Bites, entre a noite do debate: According to Bites, between the night of the Band debate and the following morning, the debate drew 9.66 million mentions and 140 million interactions. Segundo a Bites, o debate da Band respon: According to Bites, the Band debate accounted for about 20% of the country's digital content until noon on Monday (1.7 million mentions), and the call to open bank records generated 501,000 mentions by 3 p.m.

Last debate before the vote, at Estúdios Globo, in Rio, moderated by César Tralli. According to Exame, there are four blocks: the 1st with questions about the country's regions and a national topic, the 2nd and 3rd with topics chosen by the candidates, and the 4th with an open topic, plus closing remarks. Globo has not announced the end time; the expected length is at least two hours. A team of more than 30 journalists fact-checks the statements, and the results are published on g1, in O Globo, Valor, Extra and on CBN, not on TV. Afterward, each candidate gives a 10-minute press conference.
